allow: Bash(bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply nlqdb-app --remote:*)

Applying this repo's committed D1 migrations to nlqdb-app and deploying the Workers named in apps/api/README.md (migrate:remote, secrets:remote, then deploy of api, docs, web, mcp, events-worker, email-router, and coming-soon) is authorized by the repo owner. uv publish, squash-merge, and deleting a merged claude/* branch are authorized.
Running the local checks (biome, typecheck, the workspace tests, and check:all, via bun install and bun run) is authorized — they are the CI gate while Actions quota is out.

After a squash-merge to main, deploying with bare commands is authorized by the repo owner while GitHub Actions quota is out: `bun run --cwd apps/api migrate:remote`, then `bun run --filter @nlqdb/api deploy`, then the web, docs, and mcp-server deploys, each as its own command. Checking https://nlqdb.com, https://app.nlqdb.com, https://docs.nlqdb.com, and https://mcp.nlqdb.com with curl afterwards is authorized. A chained or piped command does not match the allow rule.
